context: A police officer briefs on coordination
purpose: Teach: 増員/測る/オーブン/カルテ/当番/仕上げる/仕切り/引き換え

lines.speaker: takeda_officer
lines.jp: 警察、繁忙期、増員を進めています。
lines.en: We're moving forward with staffing increases during our busy season.
lines.style: Even, professional tone. Clear authority but not defensive. Slight deliberate pause after the opening, like this is established fact. Measured pacing.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。御社、警備人員、防犯効果、測る指標、共有頂けますか。
lines.en: Yes. Could you share the indicators you use to measure your security team's crime-prevention effectiveness?
lines.style: Respectful but direct. Leans into the question with genuine curiosity, not suspicion. Keeps pace steady and conversational despite the formal content.

lines.speaker: takeda_officer
lines.jp: 地域の食堂、オーブン火災、注意喚起しています。
lines.en: We're currently alerting the community about oven fire hazards at local food establishments.
lines.style: Matter-of-fact delivery. No drama, just facts being laid out. Slight emphasis on the practicality of the warning itself.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。事件カルテ、警察データベース、参考にしています。
lines.en: Understood. We've been consulting your police database incident records for our own reference.
lines.style: Acknowledging and reciprocating. Warmth of transparency here — showing good faith. Not overly formal, just straightforward.

lines.speaker: takeda_officer
lines.jp: 交番の当番制、市民にも、周知しています。
lines.en: The patrol rotation schedule has been made known to residents as well.
lines.style: Calm, factual. This is routine communication. Slight sense of checking a box — nothing remarkable, just part of standard procedure.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。共同案件、仕上げる段階で、警察に最終確認、求めます。
lines.en: Understood. Once our joint cases reach the final stage, we'll request a final confirmation from the police.
lines.style: Respectful but assured. Shows he's thought this through. Pace is deliberate but not hesitant — this is a well-considered ask.

lines.speaker: takeda_officer
lines.jp: 場面の仕切り、警察主導で進める方針です。
lines.en: Our approach is to keep scene management under police leadership.
lines.style: Clear statement of principle. Not argumentative, just setting boundaries. Steady eye-level tone, slightly formal.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。協定、引き換えに、警察情報、提供頂きます。
lines.en: Yes. In exchange, we'll receive the information from your department as outlined.
lines.style: Closing note of agreement. Warm but businesslike. Slight breath-ease on the finish — this deal is settled.
